idea: Add an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server to ralph that exposes the main ralph operations as MCP tools. The server should expose: project_new, project_list, project_show, run (start a run and return status), status, history, tail (return recent events), quick_prd, and config_show. Use the jsonrpc-based MCP protocol over stdio transport. Create a new src/mcp/ module with the server implementation. Add a 'ralph mcp serve' CLI subcommand that starts the server. The MCP server should reuse existing library functions (create_project, Orchestrator, Workspace, etc.) rather than shelling out to the ralph binary. Each tool should accept JSON parameters matching the existing CLI args and return JSON results.
